E1.definition: g_c(x)=x for x<=1; g_c(x)=1+c*(x-1) for x>1
E1.interpretation: Tests whether spacing needs a simple surplus rescale without increasing marginal curvature.
E1.name: linear_surplus_stretch

E2.definition: g_gamma(x)=x for x<=1; g_gamma(x)=x**gamma for x>1
E2.interpretation: gamma>1 is convex elite expansion; gamma<1 is compression. The data are permitted to reject the motivating direction.
E2.name: power_above_replacement

E3.definition: g_alpha(x)=x for x<=1; g_alpha(x)=x+alpha*(x-1)**2 for x>1
E3.interpretation: Tests explicit increasing marginal elite surplus while remaining continuous and monotone.
E3.name: quadratic_surplus_hinge

dependency_gate_before_any_production_de.rule: Even if Elite Surplus V1 passes its prospective test, no production integration may occur until the relevant frozen Production V2, Age Curve V2, Replacement Level V2, and Position Weight V2 evidence has been reviewed. If those studies materially change the underlying FV construction or the QB anchor semantics, Elite Surplus V1 must be revalidated against the new frozen base rather than silently transplanted.

dependency_isolation.note: Elite Surplus V1 studies only an additional QB spacing layer. It may not retrofit or rewrite any currently frozen component candidate or use their 2026 outcomes for development.

explicit_non_goals: Do not tune Josh Allen upward or Dak Prescott downward.
Do not use KTC as a fit or selection target.
Do not change package-adjustment V1.6 or V6 research.
Do not alter non-QB FV in this study.
Do not use 2026 Week 1 as confirmation.
Do not treat Spearman improvement as evidence for a monotone transform; monotone transforms preserve rank ordering.
Do not claim historical future-PPG calibration alone proves dynasty trade utility.
Do not auto-deploy after a prospective pass.

fresh_2026_prospective_confirmation.future_ratio_denominator: realized Weeks2-8 PPG at frozen primary anchor rank among eligible QBs in the outcome window
fresh_2026_prospective_confirmation.prediction_snapshot: one frozen pre-Week-2 production snapshot; no weekly refit and no weekly candidate parameter updates
fresh_2026_prospective_confirmation.reason_week1_ineligible: The candidate family was not frozen before 2026 Week 1 outcomes were observed in other model work.

historical_development_data.rolling_fold_overlap_warning: Weekly rolling folds overlap heavily and are not independent trials.

historical_validation_and_selection.boundary_rule: A non-null optimum at a non-null parameter bound is ineligible because the preferred curvature remains unresolved. Exact null collapse is allowed and means the challenger did not beat E0.
historical_validation_and_selection.cross_season_fold: Reported as robustness only and cannot rescue a candidate that fails the frozen 2025 primary gates.
historical_validation_and_selection.if_no_candidate_qualifies: Stop Elite Surplus V1. No FV or trade-utility change. Do not create a rescue formula.
historical_validation_and_selection.selection_rule: Among eligible candidates choose the lowest 2025 primary top12 MAE. If two eligible candidates are within 0.005 absolute MAE, select the candidate with the smaller maximum absolute distortion |g(x)-x| over x in [1,3]. If still tied, select the lower candidate label.

mathematical_invariants.property_test_requirement: Before accepting any fit, test at least 1,000,000 deterministic x values spanning [0.05, 5.0] across parameter bounds and verify positivity, continuity, monotonicity, null recovery, and finite output.

normalization.important_translation_guardrail: Historical fitting operates on dimensionless production ratios; prospective confirmation operates on the identical dimensionless transform applied to frozen FV ratios. Historical fit is therefore development evidence for transform shape, not proof of dynasty value.

primary_research_anchor.source: Replacement Level V2 Phase-2 primary historical leader

parameter_fit.optimization: deterministic bounded one-dimensional optimization with a dense reproducible grid plus local refinement; no stochastic optimizer

pre_preregistration_design_evidence.restriction: These already-seen historical summaries motivated the candidate families and therefore cannot count as confirmation.

research_question: After holding the existing underlying Fundamental Value model fixed, does a monotone post-FV QB surplus transform anchored to a frozen QB replacement-rank reference improve the calibration of elite QB spacing to future realized relative production, without tuning to any named player pair?
